name: Journey Analytics Dashboard
description: End-to-end customer journey performance and optimization

cards.name: Active Journeys
cards.description: Number of customer journeys currently in progress

native.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as active_journeys
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE status = 'in_progress'
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
  AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]

cards.name: Journey Completion Rate
cards.description: Percentage of journeys that complete successfully

native.query:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
         NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as completion_rate
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})

cards.name: Average Journey Duration
cards.description: Average time to complete customer journeys

native.query:
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at))/3600)::numeric, 1) as avg_hours
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE status = 'completed' 
  AND completed_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})

cards.name: Total Journey Value
cards.description: Total customer value generated from completed journeys

native.query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(customer_value_generated), 0) as total_value
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE status = 'completed' 
  AND completed_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})

cards.name: Journey Performance by Type
cards.description: Success rate and duration by journey type

native.query:
SELECT 
    journey_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_executions,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) as completed,
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
         NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as success_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(
      CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at))/3600 
      END)::numeric, 1) as avg_duration_hours
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
GROUP BY journey_name
ORDER BY success_rate DESC

SELECT 
    CONCAT(from_department, ' → ', to_department) as handoff,
    COUNT(*) as total_handoffs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN handoff_status = 'success' THEN 1 END) as successful_handoffs,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(CASE WHEN handoff_status = 'success' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
       NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as success_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(handoff_duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) as avg_handoff_time
FROM journey_handoffs 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{department_filter}} IS NULL OR from_department = {{department_filter}} OR to_department = {{department_filter}})
GROUP BY from_department, to_department
ORDER BY success_rate DESC

SELECT 
    current_step,
    COUNT(*) as executions_at_stage,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) as completed_from_stage,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 END) as failed_at_stage,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
       NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as completion_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(
      CASE WHEN step_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(step_completed_at, NOW()) - step_started_at))/60
      END)::numeric, 1) as avg_stage_duration_minutes
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND current_step IS NOT NULL
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
GROUP BY current_step
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC

cards.name: Journey Bottlenecks
cards.description: Stages where journeys most commonly get stuck

native.query:
SELECT 
    current_step,
    journey_name,
    COUNT(*) as stuck_count,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - step_started_at))/3600)::numeric, 1) as avg_stuck_hours,
    MIN(step_started_at) as oldest_stuck
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE status = 'in_progress' 
  AND step_started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
GROUP BY current_step, journey_name
ORDER BY stuck_count DESC
LIMIT 10

cards.name: Journey ROI Analysis
cards.description: Return on investment for different journey types

native.query:
SELECT 
    journey_name,
    COUNT(*) as executions,
    ROUND(AVG(customer_value_generated)::numeric, 0) as avg_value,
    ROUND(SUM(customer_value_generated)::numeric, 0) as total_value,
    ROUND(AVG(execution_cost)::numeric, 0) as avg_cost,
    ROUND(SUM(execution_cost)::numeric, 0) as total_cost,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(customer_value_generated) - SUM(execution_cost)) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(execution_cost), 0)::numeric, 2
    ) as roi_ratio
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE status = 'completed' 
  AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
GROUP BY journey_name
ORDER BY roi_ratio DESC

cards.name: Journey Execution Timeline
cards.description: Journey execution volume and success over time

native.query:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as date,
    COUNT(*) as total_journeys,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) as completed_journeys,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 END) as failed_journeys,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 END) as in_progress_journeys,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
       NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as daily_success_rate
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)
ORDER BY date

cards.name: Agent Orchestration Performance
cards.description: Performance of AI agents within journey orchestration

native.query:
SELECT 
    je.journey_name,
    al.agent_name,
    COUNT(*) as agent_invocations,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN al.status = 'success' THEN 1 END) as successful_invocations,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(CASE WHEN al.status = 'success' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
       NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as agent_success_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(al.response_time)::numeric, 2) as avg_response_time
FROM journey_executions je
JOIN agent_logs al ON al.journey_execution_id = je.id
WHERE je.created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR je.journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
GROUP BY je.journey_name, al.agent_name
ORDER BY je.journey_name, agent_success_rate DESC

SELECT 
    journey_name,
    current_step as bottleneck_stage,
    COUNT(*) as frequency,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - step_started_at))/3600)::numeric, 1) as avg_delay_hours,
    'High delay at stage' as optimization_type,
    CASE 
      WHEN AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - step_started_at))/3600) > 24 THEN 'Critical'
      WHEN AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - step_started_at))/3600) > 8 THEN 'High'
      ELSE 'Medium'
    END as priority
FROM journey_executions 
WHERE status = 'in_progress' 
  AND step_started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
  AND ({{journey_filter}} IS NULL OR journey_name = {{journey_filter}})
GROUP BY journey_name, current_step
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY 
  CASE priority
    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1
    WHEN 'High' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  frequency DESC
LIMIT 10
